policy.missing_cache_behavior: Mark the image unavailable; do not imply visual inspection or send a fabricated image input.
policy.source_retrieval: Official sites and App Store listings linked from official sites; image bytes inspected locally with view_image.
policy.scope: Four app icon cases and two brand systems; a small design reference set, not market statistics, conversion evidence, or trademark clearance.

sources.note: HTML reader returned a JavaScript requirement; official JSON content, specifications, and change log were read.
Current editing modes are Default, Dark, Mono.
108dp layers; diagram labels a 66x66 boundary. Official Codelab clarifies a central circular safe zone; a 66/108 circle is a conservative diagnostic guide.
512px listing PNG differs from launcher assets. Transparency is discouraged where possible, not prohibited; internal lighting differs from outer drop shadow.
Current App Store icon is a separate observed image; equivalence to the historical OS26 artwork is unverified.
Slip Knots and Slant Break are exploratory lettering observations, not mandatory templates. Individual report images are not included or claimed as inspected.
Official ZIP inspected. Archive timestamps are not announcement dates. Brand restrictions were read.
Timer product page and its linked App Store listing were separately checked; UI material claims are not icon observations.
Legacy asset catalog Dark artwork uses transparent background; do not apply the imported layered-background opacity policy to it.
Describes a central circle with diameter 66 for essential information. Its prose says dpi; use the dimensionless 66/108 ratio with R3's dp layer dimensions, not a physical-dpi conversion.

references.name: Things OS 26

images.observed_region: Things icon in Mac dock around x430-546,y290-407 and iPhone dock around x1372-1487,y284-400; coordinates refer to source pixels.

visible_features: Blue rounded outer frame surrounds a light inset face with one dark check.
Dark inset boundary and a small blue lower tab persist in both shown devices.
references.interpretation: A stable frame, face and check hierarchy can survive platform rendering changes; recognition improvement was not measured.
transferable_traits: Separate dominant shape from small depth accents
do_not_copy: Things blue inbox frame, lower tab and check composition
product_contexts: Established utilities retaining familiar identity during platform updates
limits: Only displayed color appearance inspected; other variants not visually verified
No separate 32px test in this reference audit
references.input_policy: analysis_only; do not send the dock screenshot as an unlabelled positive shape target

references.name: Craft current App Store artwork
visible_features: Four broad curved pieces share rounded terminals and a narrow central cross-shaped gap.
Pink and bright blue upper pieces contrast with two navy lower pieces; edges have shallow highlights.
references.interpretation: Shared curves and gap width bind the parts; color creates upper accents and a heavier base.
transferable_traits: Use one curve and spacing rule across modular parts
do_not_copy: Craft's four-sector arrangement and pink-blue-navy placement
product_contexts: Creative organization tools with a modular product concept
limits: Not verified as the 2025 OS26 release image
Flattened thumbnail does not establish a native layer structure
No separate 32px test in this reference audit
references.input_policy: analysis_only; extract shared curvature and spacing, not the distinctive arrangement

references.name: Gentler Streak current App Store artwork
visible_features: An orange asymmetric two-lobed shape has a shallow top notch and a larger left lobe.
A darker orange rear face is offset toward the lower right; a light tile surrounds the silhouette without text or eyes.
references.interpretation: Asymmetry and a restricted warm palette provide character without a detailed mascot; depth stays secondary to the contour.
transferable_traits: Keep one large organic silhouette readable apart from highlights
do_not_copy: Gentler's specific orange lobed heart contour and proportions
product_contexts: Supportive wellbeing or personal products where soft character is appropriate
limits: Does not justify a heart or leaf default for health products
No unobserved flat master is claimed
references.input_policy: analysis_only; preserve the principle of intentional asymmetry, not the proprietary contour

references.name: (Not Boring) Timer current App Store artwork
visible_features: One white tapered needle and round hub sit on a large charcoal disc, without numerals.
Faceted light and a dark contact shadow give the needle depth; a pale disc shadow sits against the light tile.
references.interpretation: A single physical object and high contrast carry the timer association while surface treatment supports the object's construction.
transferable_traits: Choose one object and consistent lighting
Retain silhouette and contrast when surface detail shrinks
do_not_copy: The exact black dial, white sculpted needle and proportions
product_contexts: Focused tools whose interaction experience supports tactile objects
limits: Product UI descriptions are separate evidence
Does not establish an advantage for 3D in unrelated apps
references.input_policy: analysis_only; describe lighting and object hierarchy without naming a style imitation

references.name: Linear official wordmark, mark and icon
platform: App icon asset; native platform unknown

images.observed_region: Mark at left; complete Linear wordmark at right
White dimensional mark inside dark rounded tile

visible_features: A circular mark is cut by parallel diagonal gaps.
A sans-serif wordmark and a separate dimensional tile retain that mark without compressing the full name.
references.interpretation: Roles and surrounding space change with placement while the underlying construction stays consistent.
transferable_traits: Separate wordmark, mark and tile roles
Control gap rhythm and surrounding space
do_not_copy: Linear's slashed circle, wordmark, or dark SaaS tile appearance
product_contexts: Brands needing both readable full names and compact placements
limits: ZIP dates do not establish design launch dates
Published app artwork does not prove current native appearance

rights.note: Proprietary assets; do not alter, combine, imply affiliation, or use as one's own branding.

references.input_policy: analysis_only; do not condition new logo generation on these proprietary assets

references.name: Friends of Figma chapter badges

images.observed_region: Nine badge examples, including a construction diagram at top left

visible_features: A rounded F silhouette repeats across square and circular frames.
Stripe, arc, dot and photo backgrounds vary while the large foreground shape stays stable.
references.interpretation: A small set of construction rules accommodates local expression; busy backgrounds should not be assumed to survive app-icon sizes.
transferable_traits: Vary controlled composition parameters rather than assembling random multicolor fragments
do_not_copy: Figma's F silhouette, branded module arrangement, or chapter badge artwork
product_contexts: Community or creative identities with multiple related applications
limits: Not an app icon or native package
references.input_policy: analysis_only; transfer construction discipline, not letter shape or supplied patterns
